Opportunities mehnat ke bhesh mein aati hai.
"Failure ko aage badhne ke liye use karo."
"Impossible kuch nahi—'I'm possible' bolta."
Aisa karo jaise tumhara kaam farak laata hai. Yeh sach hai.
Chahe 'kar sakta' socho, ya 'nahi'—
Goal bade rakho, fail hone par bhi kuch seekhoge.
Fear ke dusri taraf hi jo chahiye.
Hazaar meel ki yatra bhi ek hi kadam se shuru hoti hai.
Jo duniya badalne ki himmat rakhte hain, wahi badalte hain.
